en.basel-kadem: 13.	With this chain, from Muhammed bin Isma’il, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Abbas, that he said: We were told by ‘Abees bin Hisham, from Abdul-Kareem bin Amru, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
with regards to His saying, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And When I proportioned him and I blew into him from My Spirit» [15:29] that he said: (It means) From My Ability.
